composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Illustrate Kotaro Katsura seated in a quiet everyday moment, wearing a plain dark-blue outer layer with a light collar. His long straight hair falls behind the shoulders, leaving the familiar adult face and both eyes clear. Keep the chin level and the smile barely present, with relaxed brows. Use detailed animation rendering, fine hair edges, controlled warm cheek light, and broad stone-gray background planes suggesting an unseen window. The clothing has no emblem or elaborate pattern. Keep the portrait centered and calm, with enough contrast around the dark hair to maintain a distinct silhouette at avatar size. Give both visible irises clear red patterns and bright catchlights. Behind the shoulders only, add two separate abstract black flame-shaped light ornaments for Amaterasu; they touch and burn nothing. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
